MVCC data-model ADR written (docs/adr/0001) + load-bearing sort POC 37/0. Decision: 1-CF, 1-byte namespace tags (META 0x00 / KEY 0x01 / REV 0x02 / LEASE 0x03) sharing one WAL = atomic multi-namespace write. KEY-CF=0x01|u64be(lenK)|K|INV(rev16) (len-prefix kills prefix hazard; INV(rev) newest-first so latest<=readRev is first forward kv-scan hit — no reverse scan needed). REV-CF=0x02|rev16 plain ascending for Watch. rev16=u64be(main)|u64be(sub). LEASE=0x03|leaseId|K for O(lease) revoke. Self-describing length-prefixed record (no protobuf dep). Consumers table maps .6/.7/.8/.13/.17. Committed locally.

CONCLUSION: the gate is the per-worker BLOCKING ask-shard closed loop — workers are parallel but each blocks on its writes commit; shard acks ~1/RTT (batch=1), so only ~1 worker frees per RTT → writes arrive staggered, never co-queue, batch stays 1 (self-sustaining).
